text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's a pleasure to be in your care.
I'm Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I still have much to learn, but if I can
touch someone's heart, that would make me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, I have to pull myself together.
Please rely on me if anything happens!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
